newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms, swap rates fluctuate.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms, swap rates fluctuate.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in slow late Friday trading, dealers said.
They said the rupiah edged up slighty to 2,318.5/19.5 from the morning high of 2,319.30 on late offshore buying.
One bank dealer said smooth closure of the headquarters of ousted minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri on Friday might have encouraged operators to unload some dollars.
Officials from the East Jakarta municipality, accompanied by about 30 security guards and police, took over a two-storey house and later put up placards saying it had been closed down.
Dealers said some operators were seen reducing short positions due to the weekend factor but many remained confident after the quiet closure of the Megawati office.
They said the focus was on Monday's liquidity.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,317.50/17.75 and 2,316.75/17.25, respectively.
Overnight swap was last at 1.25/1.75 points.
One European bank dealer said tom/next and spot/next rate rose to 0.85/1.00 and 0.70 points, respectively.
"People are still worrying about the outlook on Monday. Money rates indicated some uptrend in the afternoon," he said.
The dealer said longer-term swap rates fluctuated in the afternoon on mixed views from offshore operators.
"We saw offshore buying longer-term swap rates, possibly on profit-taking or cutting losses," he said. "But we got confused later as they unloaded again. I don't understand."
He said it might indicate a mixed market outlook.
One-month swap was last at 16.00/17.00, two at 33.00/34.0, three at 48.50/51.00 and six at 97.50/98.50 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,315/2,507 and the conversion rate also by one point to 2,315/2,363 on Friday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
